title: A vending machine that sells at 15 cents
notes: n is a nickel (5 cents) and d a dime (10). The state is the credit so far, and a move writes 1 when it sells. dnnd sells twice. Convert it and look at the Moore machine's start state: c0 is only ever entered by a sale, so its one copy writes 1, and the Moore machine writes 1 before any coin goes in.
